name: Wolpertinger
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Garmisch-Partenkirchen, where the legendary Wolpertinger awaits!**

Nestled in the heart of the **Alps**, this charming town blends breathtaking nature with a rich cultural heritage. Whether you're skiing down the slopes of **Zugspitze**, the highest peak in Germany, or exploring the picturesque old town, Garmisch-Partenkirchen promises unforgettable experiences.

Indulge in traditional Bavarian cuisine—try the fluffy **Kaiserschmarrn** or savor hearty **Schweinshaxe**—while soaking in the cozy atmosphere of local beer gardens. And don’t forget to hunt for the mythical **Wolpertinger**, the town’s playful mascot, said to bring luck to those who spot it!

From winter wonderlands to summer adventures, Garmisch-Partenkirchen is your perfect Alpine escape. **Willkommen in Garmisch-Partenkirchen!** 🏔️✨
